Upstream: https://github.com/hyesu-jang/RaPlace
Paper: RaPlace (IROS 2023).
Source: user-supplied RaPlace-main/RaPlace-main/raplace_cpp, copied 2026-10-31.
This is the upstream RaPlace-Light C++ port, not the MATLAB/Python implementation.
The supplied archive has no LICENSE file; no new license is asserted here.

Original SHA256:
raplace.hpp 246D25B45244702170319BB62C90FC1EE8782861EF28F8F489AA6D2A52C93C00
raplace.cpp 8197F16A421E827EDFD3F622086E4319ABED953F61754D25C4C013E9A9CD949B

Local changes:
- Expose the existing fromCart core for point-cloud BEV input. Radon/FFT and
  correlation formulas, work_size=69, n_theta=180, n_theta_out=18 are retained.
- Fix candidate count N-exclude_recent+1 to N-exclude_recent, so offline-map
  searches with exclude_recent=0 include all N entries without reading past N.
- Validate descriptor sizes/types and reject zero/nonfinite query descriptors.
- Resolve exact correlation ties by the lower map-array index.
- Clamp tiny negative distances due to floating-point self-match roundoff to 0.

Point-cloud rasterization, ROS map loading, ICP and evaluation are separate
adapter code in src/raplace_place_recognition.cpp and include/dyna_rc/raplace_input.h.
